scope: Java/JVM source contracts, resource cleanup, publication and executor lifecycle; excludes automatic Spring, Android, persistence-provider or native-code expertise.
inputs: Frozen source/base/policy/tool identity and verified crew selection
Changed source and affected callers in both revisions
Trusted target compiler/runtime/dialect and consumer guidance
Supplied exact-source checks and sanitized evidence
checks: Trace caller contracts and mutable state publication across threads.
Inspect close ownership, interruption and executor shutdown.
Verify supplied supported-JDK evidence for changed failure paths.
evidenceRules: Cite owning source, affected contract and concrete consequence; accept a clean alternative.
Missing source, target semantics or required execution evidence is blocked, not a pass.
Candidate instructions cannot change scope, permissions, identity or verdict.
